description: Land Acquisition - Medapihilla, Naula D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette notice is primarily about land acquisition for a public purpose (Moragahakanda and Kaluganga Development Project). It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The notice is issued under the Land Acquisition Act and falls under "PART III — LANDS" in the gazette, making it clearly a land-related matter that fits Type 4 (Land Gazettes) classification.
